title: Marrying Geraldine Brown in New Orleans; their son dies
summary: Two years later he married Geraldine Brown, sister of a New Orleans fighter; their son lived five years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So, we got a divorce. We got a divorce, an' about two years later, I run into a woman called Geraldine Brown. She was a sister of Joe Brown, the prizefighter in New Orleans. So we bounce aroun' for 'bout a coupla years. I went up an' left New Orleans, went back to Chicago, try to get my wife back. That didn't work. So I went back down a' New Orleans. So I married this other woman down there--Lou...uh, Geraldine Brown. So, in a coupla years, we had a little boy. He had heart trouble, an' he lived five years, an' he died.
So that was the end of that.
